description: The nine locked coverage-matrix rows (Phase-1 D-05/D-06) in their locked order. The order must equal parity.AllDomains(); matrix_test.go enforces it.

domains.title: Endpoints
domains.surface: HTTP-visible request and response behaviour of /openrtb2/auction, /openrtb2/amp, /openrtb2/video and the support endpoints.

domains.title: Config and bootstrap
domains.surface: Config keys, defaults and env bindings (GET /__parity/config) and bidder metadata loading (GET /__parity/bidders).

domains.title: Stored data
domains.surface: Stored requests and imps, request merging and account resolution.

domains.title: Auction lifecycle
domains.surface: Validation, request shaping, bidder fan-out, response assembly and timeouts.

domains.title: Policy, privacy and identity
domains.surface: Floors, currency, bid adjustments, targeting, multibid, privacy enforcement and identity.

domains.title: Bidders and adapters
domains.surface: Adapter request building (MakeRequests), outbound bidder calls and response parsing (MakeBids).

domains.title: Hooks and modules
domains.surface: Module hooks, execution plans and hook outcomes.

domains.title: Cache and support flows
domains.surface: Prebid Cache writes, stored responses, events and vtrack.

domains.title: Cutover proof
domains.surface: Prometheus metric deltas, analytics calls and other operational evidence.
